title: Polymarket withdraws wager on Patrick Mahomes playing in Week 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Polymarket withdraws wager on Patrick Mahomes playing in Week 1
sources.description: At a time when the scrutiny of prediction markets seems to be increasing, Polymarket has withdrawn a wager based on Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes playing in his team's Week 1 game against the Broncos.
